754639.rationale: Rupert Lowe was elected for Reform in Great Yarmouth in 2024 and now leads Restore Britain. Of the party leaders who sit as MPs, he has the clearest reason to seek a fresh mandate under his new party's banner: Restore's local affiliate won all its Great Yarmouth seats in May, while Restore managed only 6.8% in Makerfield (June 18). No pre-June-24 report of such plans was found.
754639.next_info: UK news July 1-9, 2026 (BBC/Guardian) on any MP resigning to re-contest; Restore Britain or Lowe statements after Makerfield.

76066.rationale: Munteanu was still PM on June 24 amid the MoldATSA scandal (Sandu's cousin) and an internal PAS feud, so his resignation came after the search cutoff. With no information on a successor, this is a diffuse prior over senior PAS and cabinet figures (deputy PMs, ex-PM Recean, Speaker Grosu).
76066.next_info: Late June / early July 2026: Sandu's designation decree for a PM candidate, then the parliament confidence vote (expected by about July 8).

249565.rationale: TASS (May 31) and The Duran reported that Zelensky told Sen. Blumenthal that Budanov, now head of the Presidential Office, would replace Syrskyi, possibly in early autumn. The alternatives are the usual senior-command names (Hnatov is Chief of General Staff; Drapatyi; Brovdi 'Madyar', the most trusted officer in KIIS polling). Forecast assumes an appointment actually happens.
249565.next_info: Any presidential decree dismissing Syrskyi (watch for the fall of Kostiantynivka or a broad reshuffle); close date July 21, 2026.

844962.rationale: Ex-foreign minister Kuleba told KURS on April 14, 2026 that 'Ukraine needs wartime elections' and called himself 'in a critical minority'. That is an explicit early call by a major figure. The question's mid-August date suggests the crediting article may be later and name someone else, so mass is spread across other figures.
844962.next_info: Ukrainian and Western reporting through Aug 31, 2026 on calls for wartime elections; any 'first major figure' framing.

903565.rationale: Germany issued warrants for six Ukrainians in Aug 2025. Kuznietsov is in German custody (arrested Aug 2025), and Poland refused to extradite diver Zhuravlov in Oct 2025. The other suspects are unnamed and probably in Ukraine, so a new arrest in any given month is unlikely.
903565.next_info: German Federal Prosecutor (GBA) announcements in August 2026; Kuznietsov indictment/custody review (about Aug 28).

874244.rationale: On June 24 Lavrov and Peskov said they expect envoys Witkoff and Kushner to visit Moscow once they are free of Iran talks. Witkoff is the formal senior official and has made repeated Moscow trips.
874244.next_info: CBS News reporting in August 2026; the end of the Iran negotiations should free Witkoff and Kushner for Russia.

921981.rationale: The SCO summit is in Bishkek, Aug 31-Sep 1, 2026, and Ushakov confirmed Putin will attend. Erdogan has met Putin at every recent SCO summit, and Ukraine settlement is a standard agenda item with him. Modi is likely to attend and a Putin bilateral was flagged. Guterres is attending SCO+.
921981.next_info: Ushakov/Peskov briefing on Putin's Bishkek bilaterals (usually 2-5 days before, about Aug 26-29).

174389.rationale: Past trilateral rounds were in Abu Dhabi and Geneva. In March 2026 Zelensky named Switzerland or Turkey as likely venues and doubted the UAE. The US has previously proposed hosting (Miami). Talks paused during the Iran war; the Kremlin expects them to resume.
174389.next_info: Zelensky statements about any US-proposed venue through Sep 25, 2026; Witkoff/Kushner availability after Iran.

759359.rationale: Russia has hit about 140 fuel stations since April (NaftoRynok), mostly in Sumy, Kharkiv, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions plus Kyiv. There were also strikes in Odesa oblast and Chernihiv region, and Sumy city was hit on June 24. Which cities count as 'away from front lines' is ambiguous.
759359.next_info: Ukrainian city military administration reports Sep 1-11, 2026.

423956.rationale: The Magyar (Tisza) government is pursuing Orban-era corruption. On May 22, 2026 police moved a 'hutlen kezeles' (misappropriation) complaint over Rogan's Cabinet Office contracts (about HUF 50bn) to the Budapest economic-crime division. Lazar is a sitting Fidesz MP. Whether a vote happens specifically in September is uncertain.
423956.next_info: Prosecutor requests to suspend immunity and votes in the Hungarian parliament's autumn session (September 2026).

120116.rationale: King Harald (89) was hospitalized in Tenerife in Feb 2026 but recovered and has resumed duties (May 17 balcony appearance). The roughly 2-month mortality risk at his age is a few percent, and he has ruled out abdication.
120116.next_info: Royal House health bulletins through Aug 29, 2026.

81247.rationale: Polls before the Sep 20 vote: Civey (June) CDU 22, AfD 18, Greens 17, Linke 15, SPD 14. INSA (May) CDU 20, AfD 18. Infratest (late April) CDU 19, with Greens, Linke and AfD at 18. CDU leads by 2-4 points but is trending down in a fragmented field.
81247.next_info: Berlin polls (Infratest/RBB, Civey, INSA, Forsa) through September; election Sep 20, 2026.

964047.rationale: Bulgaria won 2026 and hosts 2027. Spain, Ireland, the Netherlands, Slovenia and Iceland boycotted 2026. RTVE has asked for guarantees of political neutrality and is reviewing participation. Belgium's VRT (its turn in 2027) says the chances are 'slim'. RTE sees 'no reason' to change. AVROTROS was awaiting the EBU evaluation. Slovenia under Jansa is less likely to boycott.
964047.next_info: Broadcaster decisions in Aug-Sep 2026 (RTVE board, VRT, RTE review, AVROTROS/NPO, RUV board).

25611.rationale: Per the Mirror (Dec 2025), the Met sent full files on two of the six suspects to the CPS. The Mirror approached Mutabaruka and Bajinya, which suggests they are the two. Forecast assumes a charge is actually announced in 2026.
25611.next_info: CPS charging announcement (question close Sep 21, 2026; deadline Dec 31, 2026).

342722.rationale: The adult defendants were sent to the Paris tribunal correctionnel: Ilyas Kherbouch ('Ganito', alleged main organizer, an escapee with a prior 7-year sentence), Khyan M. ('Kiki', co-organizer) and a junior accomplice. The minors are tried separately in juvenile court. The main organizer is most likely to get the longest sentence.
342722.next_info: Paris criminal court trial and verdict (about early Sep 2026).
